info.name: Cintoo Open Account Usage Report API

params.name: accountRef
params.description: The Id or Urn of the account

params.name: subscriptionRef
params.description: The Id or Urn of the subscription

params.name: from
params.description: The date to start to retrieve usage report data from (included)

params.name: until
params.description: The date to start to retrieve usage report data from (included)

params.name: includeDeleted

items.docs: BETA- Generate an Usage Report, listing actions done per day, per user, per project on a given subscription. This endpoint is unavailable when the tenant setting `hidePrivacyData` is enabled.
